messages:
Ana (infra): Quick Mendoza cutover update — target Tue 2026-03-24 02:00 UTC. Need signoff on routing + KMS + DB residency. Tentative owners: routing=Leo, kms=Tara, db=Praveen. Please ack. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/mendoza-cutover :calendar:
Praveen: Ack. DB replica promotion script ready, but question — will reads from LatAm be forced to local egress or still route via us-west? If local, we need a read-replica in the region and residency tags on connections.
Leo: I'm on routing. Small question about egress ACLs — do we allow wide S3 egress or restrict to cloud peering IPs? Current policy draft:
```yaml
- src: mendoza
  dest: s3
  allowed: [10.12.0.0/16, 52.94.0.0/16]
```
If we restrict, pre-signed URL flows might break. Also adding fallback requirement to avoid capacity storms.
Tara: KMS team: OK to create keys, but we need alias pattern and the service principal. Proposed alias: `alias/redwood/mendoza/{env}` and SA `infra-mendoza` for key usage. Who will create the SA? @Julie?
Julie: I can create infra-mendoza SA. Approved. I'll also loop in Security for policy review. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Smoke tests for mendoza VPC completed — 12 passed, 1 warning (dns timeout flake). CI: https://ci.redwood/internal/1234
Praveen: For DB cutover: snapshot sync ETA ~3h. After cutover we'll run `promote_replica.sh`. I opened PR: https://git.redwood/infra/prs/4242 — reviewers: @Ana @Leo.
Ana (infra): Thanks. @Leo please review PR by EOD. If we restrict S3 egress, add NAT policy to allow pre-signed domains (s3.amazonaws.com / *.storage.redwood). @Tara once KMS alias naming confirmed I'll create key in staging and then prod after security signoff.
Leo: Reviewing PR now. Also please add explicit fallback policy: if mendoza util >90% route to us-west. Suggest adding this snippet to routing config:
```json
{"route_preference": ["mendoza:primary", "us-west:failover"], "capacity_threshold": 0.9}
```
Tara: Alias name `alias/redwood/mendoza/{env}` works for us. I'll create staging keys tomorrow and queue prod creation after Security ack. @Julie please confirm auditing requirements.
Julie: Security will do a quick review this afternoon. Reminder: enable audit logs — `cloud.kms.logs` -> `longterm-audit` bucket and ensure key rotation policy is set.
Ana (infra): Action items recap: Leo — routing changes + PR review; Praveen — promote script + snapshot; Tara — create KMS keys in staging (prod after signoff); Julie — security signoff + audit config. I'll send calendar invite + cutover channel. Target window Tue 02:00 UTC. :rocket:
sre-oncall: Noted — I'll own rollback play and monitor SLOs during the window.
Leo: ack :eyes:
